The Museum of Modern Art | New York City | partial onsite | $140k-$160k We’re looking for a Senior Front-End Developer to own our technical design system and architecture. You’ll work at the intersection of culture and technology, delivering high-performance, accessible experiences for our public-facing and internal apps.

* Stack: Ruby on Rails, Tailwind CSS, Stimulus. * Focus: Lightweight, modern web standards over heavy JS frameworks. * Role: Lead our front-end codebase, design a reusable component library, and mentor the team. * Requirements: 5+ years of experience, expert JS/CSS, and deep Rails ecosystem knowledge.

Email resume to rik_vanmechelen<at>moma.org (please mention HN)
